name: Navigator Company SA
summary: The Navigator Company, S.A. manufactures and markets pulp and paper products in Portugal. It operates through Market Pulp, UWF Paper, Tissue Paper, and Other segments. The company offers its products under the Navigator, Multioffice, Discovery, explorer, Inacopia, Target, Pioneer, SOPORSET, INASET, and target plus brands for professional and home use. It also produces bleached eucalyptus kraft pulp, uncoated writing and printing thin paper, and domestic consumption paper. The company also exports its products to approximately 130 countries worldwide. The company was formerly known as Portucel, S.A. and changed its name to The Navigator Company, S.A. in February 2016.
